name: Wall push-up
description: Hands on a wall, the elbows bend to bring the chest toward the wall, then straighten. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand side-on to the screen, facing a wall at arm's length.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back until your arms are straight.

camera.guidance: Stand side-on so shoulder, elbow, wrist and hip stay in view.

messages.target_not_reached: Bend your elbows a little further.

form_rules.message: Keep your body in a straight line.

setup: Stand side-on to the screen, facing a wall at about arm's length.
Place your hands flat on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than your shoulders.

cues.start: Arms straight, hands on the wall.
cues.move: Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
cues.back: Push back until your arms are straight.

key_points: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your heels on the floor.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds in and 2 seconds out.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
